Name: Dynamic Wall-Length Gothic Windows (for CP and AT)
Author: Morghoula
Description:
[color=#674ea7][size=4][b]Gothic-styled windows that no one asked for! Although they are not technically [i]real [/i]windows, the CP version is fully dynamic with the seasons, time of day, and weather.  
[/b][/size][/color]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/KjG9ptb/features.png[/img]
[b][u]Content Patcher Version [color=#6aa84f](Fully Dynamic)[/color][/u]
[/b][list]
[*]Adds new items to the game (does NOT replace other items) that can be found under "paintings" in the furniture catalogue or cheated into the game using CJB Cheats. 
[*]Can be purchased from Robin's shop for 500g each.
[*]Fully dynamic to season and weather! The CP version of these windows will change automatically on these conditions.
[*]Five available colors: Black, Mahogany (to match Modern Gothic Furniture), Vanilla, and Brown and White (to match Rustic Country Town Interiors)
[*]Two different types: Unlit and 'lit'. Because these can't be real windows, I've created a second version that appears to glow similar to how in-game windows would.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/vZMrSJH/img.png[/img]﻿[/list][i]('Lit' version on the left, unlit version on the right, during the day)﻿[/i]
[b][u]

AT Version [color=#cc4125](NOT DYNAMIC)[/color]
[/u][/b][list]
[*]Can be found by using the Paint Bucket on the "Log Panel" furniture item.
[*]Unlike the CP version, the AT windows are not auto-seasonal and do not change at night. You will have to manually change your windows every season using the Paint Bucket.
[*]Like the CP version, it comes in 5 colors, each with a lit and unlit option.
[*][color=#cc4125]Does NOT come with the night/rain versions.[/color]
[/list]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/f9cLWRL/mods-in-the-screenshots.png[/img]﻿
There are probably many I am going to accidentally miss.

[list]
[*]These windows were designed to go with many of the furniture items from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3702]Modern Gothic Interior[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16438]Aimon's Tidy Cozy Farmhouse[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3702][color=#e8e6e3][/color][/url][color=#e8e6e3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20640]Shyzie's Witchy Goblincore Rugs[/url][/color]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10982]Adorable Cottage Bathroom and Furniture[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14252]Void's Weird Furniture[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18490]Opulence[/url] furniture
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14644]West Elm Furniture[/url]
[*]Industrial Furniture for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17656]AT [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5444]CP﻿﻿﻿﻿[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18957]Scandanavian Livin' Pack[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14651]Lune's Offerings[/url]
